data.title: Getting Started in F-1 Status Tutorial
data.text:
# Getting Started in F-1 Status Tutorial

## Getting Started in F-1 Status Tutorial

Maintaining Status

- Keep your passport and I-20 valid. Your visa can expire and this does not affect your
F-1 status.
- Enroll in a full course load at WSU every Fall and Spring term (12 credits for undergraduate
students, 9 credits for graduate students)
- Only one 100% online course, up to 3 credits, counts towards minimum enrollment requirement.
- Audited courses never count towards minimum enrollment requirement.
- Do not work off-campus without authorization
- Avoid any violation of U.S. criminal law
- Follow the required procedures for:
- Transferring to another school
- Extending your I-20 before it expires
- Reporting a change of address to OIE within 10 days

data.title: F-1 Status and Employment
data.text:
# F-1 Status and Employment

## Getting Started in F-1 Status Tutorial

F-1 Status and Employment

- On-campus employment is allowed up to 20 hours per week during Fall and Spring semesters, up to 40 hours
per week during school breaks
- F-1 students may apply for a Social Security Number (SSN) upon receiving a job offer
- After one fall and one spring semester in the U.S., students may qualify for CPT ( Curricular Practical Training) which is an opportunity to receive academic training in their major field of study.
- After completion of program, a student may apply for 12 months of post-completion
Optional Practical Training (OPT) authorization.
- Some students may be eligible for a 24-month OPT extension if they complete a STEM degree and have a qualifying employer.

data.title: Authorized Early Withdrawal
data.text:
Dropping below a full course load of study before receiving authorization from an
advisor at International Education is a violation of status and will result in termination
of the student's SEVIS record for the negative reason, “Unauthorized Withdrawal.”
Termination, for this reason, may cause difficulty when attempting to return to the
U.S. in the future.

The   Authorized Early Withdrawal  can be requested and completed online. **PLEASE REVIEW THE FORM CAREFULLY – ONCE THE FORM IS SUBMITTED, THE STUDENT WILL HAVE
15 DAYS TO EXIT THE U.S.**

## On-Campus Employment - 8CFR214.2(f)(9)(i)

**Eligibility:**

1. Student must be enrolled full-time at WSU (12 hours for undergraduate students; 9
hours for graduate students), or have an approved Reduced Course Load form or Full
Course Load certification on file at the Office of International Education.
2. Student must have a valid I-20 issued by WSU
3. Student must have a social security number (see information about obtaining a social security card)

data.title: CPT Resources
data.text:
At WSU, full-time CPT is typically only authorized during summer terms and over the
winter break, though some exceptions may exist for academic reasons.  Guaranteeing
a certain amount of full-time CPT may be the policy at some schools, but not at WSU.

I want to do full-time CPT in my final term because I only have one class to take.
Can I do that?

The number of hours you are allowed to work is not based on your course load. At WSU,
CPT during fall and spring semesters is generally limited to 20 hours per week.

How early can I request a CPT form?

While students cannot begin participating in CPT until they meet the one academic
year eligibility requirement, they can start the process of obtaining a CPT application
in advance.
